conceptZh: 扭蛋小怪獸在夜燈下玩躲貓貓，筆畫一個個從角落探出頭又縮回去。
object: a fuzzy gachapon creature with a toy night-lamp
morph: strokes of 夜 sneak in from corners, dodge the creature under lamp light, then settle
creativeAngle: 躲貓貓：夜燈一閃，筆畫就躲。
promptEn: An 8-second animated clip on a pale periwinkle background, with one single Traditional Chinese glyph 夜 as the only text on screen, drawn in warm amber solid strokes, centered, uncropped, about 70% of frame height with generous margins. 0-1.7s: a round fuzzy mint creature bursts out of a capsule and bounces off a small toy night-lamp, which blinks on; the first 夜 is spoken as the top lid-like 亠 stroke peeks in from the upper edge and ducks away. 1.7-3.4s: the lamp flickers and the remaining strokes dart in from different corners, dodging as the creature leaps at them and bounces off the walls; the second 夜 is spoken as it pins the last piece with a belly flop and everything snaps into the glyph. 3.4-5s: 夜市 is spoken as a string of paper lanterns and a tiny toy food cart with steam pop up on the horizon behind the glyph (animated shapes only). 5-8s: hold; the creature spins up a firefly, giggling, glyph still. Audio: a warm off-screen voice in clear Taiwanese Mandarin reads exactly "夜、夜、夜市" (ㄧㄝˋ、ㄧㄝˋ、ㄧㄝˋ ㄕˋ), slowly and distinctly with clear tones, a short pause between the two single utterances, and stops after the word; no other speech, no subtitles, no vocabulary text. Final 3 seconds (5-8s): the glyph 夜 is perfectly still and fully readable while the lead keeps a small joyful motion away from the strokes. Bright but not neon palette, no watermark, no flashing, no other writing.
